notes.title: Patch 1
notes.notes:
Patch 1

Forest Tribe
- Archer damage decreased (54 > 24)
- Archer health decreased (230 > 190)
- Passive healing increased (100 > 200)

Mushroom Tribe
- Mini Mushroom damage increased (24 > 30)
- Mini Mushroom health increased (90 > 160)
- Big Fungus move speed increased (0.6 > 0.9)
- Big Fungus damage increased (106 > 156)

Frost Tribe
- No changes

Global
- Main Building health increased (4000 > 5000)
- Mini defense building attack speed increased
- Spell cost increased (9 > 11)

Bug Fixes
- Fixed a bug where destroying and replacing a building in the same round allowed spells to destroy the new one

Other
- Stat tracking adjustments (Should be easier to detect which tribes are performing better than others)
